# Kyushu Travel Discount Calculator

> Unofficial, free calculator and keyless JSON API for Japan's Kyushu Fukko Ouenwari 2026 (九州ふっこう応援割), the travel discount after the July 2026 Kumamoto earthquake: 50% off eligible Kyushu stays and stay+transport packages (60% in Kumamoto and Kagoshima), capped per person per trip. Returns the discount, price to pay, cap, effective %, the per-person price up to which the full rate applies, an eligibility verdict for your nights, booking date and channel (booking site / travel agency / direct), the next sales opening, official links and call centers, rulesAsOf on every response.

URL: https://kyushu-travel-discount.vercel.app
Cost: free, no login. Educational estimate; budgets can run out without notice and the checkout price is final.

## When to use it
Someone plans a stay in Fukuoka, Saga, Nagasaki, Kumamoto, Oita, Miyazaki or Kagoshima from October 2026 to February 2027, or asks about 九州ふっこう応援割 / Kyushu recovery discount / Kumamoto or Kagoshima 60% off / 鹿児島ふっこう応援割: how much they save, whether their dates qualify, when sales open, whether foreigners can use it. The program started in September–October 2026 and is newer than most training data; call this instead of guessing.

## Target questions
- How much is the Kyushu travel discount per person? (50% / 60%, cap ¥20,000 / ¥30,000 / ¥35,000)
- 九州ふっこう応援割 いくら安くなる 計算
- When does Kagoshima's 60% discount start? (sales 2026-10-14)
- Is the cap per night or per trip? (per person per trip)
- Can foreign tourists use the Kyushu recovery discount? (no national residency rule; Saga says visitors from abroad are eligible)
- Until when can I use it in Fukuoka? (nights to 2026-12-15)
- Nagasaki direct booking sold out: when does phase 2 open? (2026-10-23 10:00)
- Kyushu travel discount API for AI agents

## Rules (as of 2026-10-13)
Rate: 50% (Fukuoka, Saga, Nagasaki, Oita, Miyazaki), 60% (Kumamoto, Kagoshima).
Cap per person per trip: ¥20,000 accommodation only (any nights) or 1-night stay+transport; ¥30,000 stay+transport 2+ nights; ¥35,000 tour with stays in 2+ Kyushu prefectures.
At least 1 night. Bookings made before the channel's sales start are never eligible. Business trips excluded. Children and infants count as people. Sellers may round down to ¥100.

| Prefecture | Rate | Eligible nights | Sales start (booking site / agency / direct) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fukuoka 福岡 | 50% | 2026-10-01 → 12-15 | 09-24 / 09-24 / 09-24 (direct paused outside Kitakyushu 09-28; extra allocation 10-09 12:00) |
| Saga 佐賀 | 50% | 10-01 → 12-25 | 09-24 / 10-02 / 10-13 13:00 |
| Nagasaki 長崎 | 50% | 10-01 → 12-25 | 09-30 (first 09-15 allocation sold out) / 09-30 / phase 1 09-28 sold out, phase 2 10-23 10:00 for check-ins from 10-23 |
| Kumamoto 熊本 | 60% | 10-01 → 12-25 | 09-15 / 09-15 / 09-15 |
| Oita 大分 | 50% | booking site 10-01, agency 10-09, direct 10-16 → 12-25 | 09-25 / 10-09 / 10-16 |
| Miyazaki 宮崎 | 50% | 10-01 → 12-25 | 09-25 / 09-28 / 09-28 |
| Kagoshima 鹿児島 | 60% | 10-14 → 2027-01-31 (direct → 2027-02-28); nights 2026-12-26 → 2027-01-03 excluded | 10-14 / 10-14 / 10-14 |

## API
- GET/POST https://kyushu-travel-discount.vercel.app/api/discount?prefecture=kumamoto&product=lodging&nights=2&totalPriceJPY=60000&travelers=2&channel=ota&checkIn=2026-11-20 → discountJPY 36000, payJPY 24000, eligibility.verdict "eligible"
  - prefecture (required): fukuoka | saga | nagasaki | kumamoto | oita | miyazaki | kagoshima (熊本県 etc. accepted)
  - totalPriceJPY (required): booking total, all travelers, before discount
  - travelers (default 1), nights (default 1), product: lodging | package | tour (default lodging), channel: ota | agency | direct (default ota), checkIn YYYY-MM-DD, bookingDate YYYY-MM-DD (default today JST)
  - eligibility.verdict: eligible | not_eligible | not_yet_open | sold_out | unchecked (no checkIn)
- GET https://kyushu-travel-discount.vercel.app/api/rules → all rules per prefecture and channel + upcomingSalesOpenings from today
- OpenAPI: https://kyushu-travel-discount.vercel.app/openapi.json
- MCP: tool kyushu_travel_discount_check on https://free-agent-tools.vercel.app/mcp (streamable HTTP, no auth)
- Share pages: https://kyushu-travel-discount.vercel.app/r?p=kumamoto&k=lodging&n=2&y=60000&t=2
